responses.message: I recommend the Kenmore listed at Kohl’s for $764.99. Its matched listing describes an integrated conical burr grinder with 30 settings and a steam wand, covering whole-bean espresso and milk steaming in one machine. Making your two drinks sequentially fits this workflow; expect to learn grinding, tamping and milk steaming, and to clean the milk-contact parts after use. On ordinary household-purchase assumptions, I expect the standard operating accessories and US compatibility, although the supplied evidence does not enumerate the accessories or explicitly establish voltage. This is a credible complete-setup prospect within your $800 limit, with $35.01 remaining. The listing match supports the description; it does not independently verify performance or seller recourse.
